change.title: Add note-generation status UI
change.summary: The change adds progress and failure states for agent notes, updates the landing-page brief, and expands the wider project with demo, CLI, serving, summary, and test changes.
change.why: The changes appear to support incremental note generation and a larger interactive demonstration while keeping the diff reviewable during generation.
highlights: The app now shows writing, stopped, and reconnecting states.
The full change adds demo data, CLI and serving scripts, summary generation updates, documentation changes, and related tests.
The supplied batch updates app styling and note-state rendering.
risks: Note readiness falls back to complete snapshot status, which may affect files without individual readiness data.

summary.title: Update landing-page brief
summary.what: The design brief now calls for an illustrative ten-file todo demo and a reader view that matches the app.
summary.why: The brief appears to align the static landing page with the expanded interactive demo and current product surface.
details: Adds the todo demo to the proof and constraints.
Requires labels that mark the demo as illustrative.

summary.title: Style note states
summary.what: The stylesheet adds blue styles for notes being written and amber styles for stopped notes, plus a pending-note marker and text color.
summary.why: These styles appear to distinguish note-generation states from normal watching and error states.
details: Adds blue live-dot and pending-note styles.
Adds amber stopped-note styles and disables its ring animation.
Colors pending progress text blue.

summary.title: Render note progress
summary.what: The page now reads note status from the snapshot and renders writing or stopped placeholders when the current file’s note is unavailable.
summary.why: The change appears to let reviewers inspect diffs while notes generate and explain when generation stops.
details: Supports the checkout target kind.
Shows note progress in the header and accessible status text.
Displays completed-file counts during generation or failure.
Hides normal note details until the current note is ready.
risks: A failed note state hides the file’s existing summary when that file is not ready.
The fallback treats notes as ready when snapshot-level completion is absent, which may mask missing per-file status.

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import { writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import {
+  todoDemoChange,
+  todoDemoFiles,
+} from "../docs/todo-demo.js";
+
+const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
+const generatedAt = "2026-07-29T06:30:00.000Z";
+const fingerprint = createHash("sha256")
+  .update(JSON.stringify({ change: todoDemoChange, files: todoDemoFiles }))
+  .digest("hex");
+
+const snapshot = {
+  version: fingerprint.slice(0, 12),
+  generatedAt,
+  repo: {
+    name: "todo-list-demo",
+    root: "/demo/todo-list",
+    base: "main",
+    head: "feature/todo-filters",

+    reviewFingerprint: fingerprint,
+    generatedFor: fingerprint,
+    fresh: true,
+    complete: true,
+  },
+  files: todoDemoFiles,
+};
+
+const summaries = {
+  change: todoDemoChange,
+  files: Object.fromEntries(
+    todoDemoFiles.map((file) => [file.path, file.summary]),
+  ),
+};
+
+await Promise.all([
+  writeFile(

+  ),
+]);
